title: THE GUIDE OF THE YEAR
text:
An exceptional visit to the Alhambra and the Generalife thanks to Mr. Yacoubi

We want to express our most sincere congratulations and gratitude to Mr. Yacoubi for his kindness, professionalism, and extraordinary knowledge of the history of the Alhambra and the Generalife.

We have enjoyed a magnificent visit, in which he not only explained the history of these monuments to us, but also revealed numerous details of their architecture, their inscriptions, their symbology, and the meaning of many elements that, otherwise, would have gone unnoticed.

title: ★★★★★ An unforgettable tour of the Alhambra and Generalife, thanks to Eduardo!
text:
Our visit to the Alhambra was one of the highlights of our trip to Granada, and that's largely because of our guide, Eduardo. His knowledge is remarkable. He brought the history of this extraordinary place to life, from the Nasrid palaces to the stories behind the intricate tilework and carvings, and made centuries of history feel vivid and personal.
